Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 1999
CHOLISTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT 1999
ACT XIII OF 1999
An Act further to amend the Cholistan Development
Authority Act, 1976
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 4th September, 1999]
No.Legis.2(46)/99/190, dated
4-9-1999.---The Cholistan Development Authority (Amendment) Bill. 1999, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 20th August, 1999 and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 31st August, 1999, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Cholistan Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Addition of section 4-A in Act XIV of 1976

ACT XIII OF 1999
CHOLISTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT 1999
ACT XIII OF 1999
An Act further to amend the Cholistan Development
Authority Act, 1976
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 4th September, 1999]
No.Legis.2(46)/99/190, dated
4-9-1999.---The Cholistan Development Authority (Amendment) Bill. 1999, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 20th August, 1999 and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 31st August, 1999, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Addition of section 4-A in Act XIV of 1976.--In the Cholistan
Development Authority Act, 1976 (XIV of 1976) hereinafter referred is :: the
said Act after section 4 the following section 4-A shall be added: -
"4-A. Vice
Chairman.--(1) The Government may designate member as Vice-Chairman of the
Authority.
(2) The
Vice-Chairman shall perform such functions including the functions of the
Managing Director as may be assigned to him by the Authority. "

Amendment of section 13 of Act XIV of 1973

ACT XIII OF 1999
CHOLISTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT 1999
ACT XIII OF 1999
An Act further to amend the Cholistan Development
Authority Act, 1976
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 4th September, 1999]
No.Legis.2(46)/99/190, dated
4-9-1999.---The Cholistan Development Authority (Amendment) Bill. 1999, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 20th August, 1999 and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 31st August, 1999, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
3. Amendment of section 13 of
Act XIV of 1976.--In the said Act in section 13 for subsection
(4) the following shall be substituted:--
"(4) The
meetings of the Authority shall be presided over by the Chairman and in his
absence by the Vice-Chairman and in the absence of both by the member of the
Authority elected for the purpose by the members present from amongst
themselves."

Repeal
